dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Did I find anything? Hmm... How about a remaining belief in the Goddess of Flowers? Eh, I'm afraid whatever is left of that belief has been wiped out now — it's gone for good.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: And... I found many books smuggled out of the Akademiya. The amount is very huge if I do say so.

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: Some of which are completely foreign to me... Uh, for instance... there are books about "films." What did they want these for?

dialogues.speaker: Tanjiyy
dialogues.text: But apparently, we were wrong to presume that the desert folks were illiterate fools who would turn their noses up at knowledge... They were truly extraordinary.
